highlights.title: Bot replies no longer look like warnings
highlights.text: A bot's reply is now plain text with a thin line in its avatar's colour, so you still see who is talking. Coloured boxes are kept for errors, warnings and questions for you.

highlights.title: Small avatars show their faces clearly
highlights.text: In the sidebar and on phone replies, a bot's mood, status and model marks now sit on the avatar's corner instead of over its face. Only each bot's newest reply shows how it feels.

fixes: Deleting a bot no longer blanks the page; if its chat was open you move to another chat, and a page error shows a Reload button.
kwant.si now has a Deploy on Railway card, so you can run kwant in the cloud in one click without your own server.
An approval request from a team's member bot now shows in the team chat, not only the lead's.
A bot's avatar perks up again when you send it a message; the thinking blink no longer cuts the perk-up off.
